description: Verify that UDP receive operations return the source UDP port correctly to the upper layer (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Applications often need the sender's port to reply or to demultiplex flows. The receive primitive MUST report the actual src_port on the wire — anything else makes reply-routing impossible.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: UDP datagram with a known src_port = K
2. Tester → DUT: OpGetReceivedUdp UT-query

3. Observation:
   • UT Confirmation reports src_port == K   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reported src_port matches what was sent.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_field_mismatch — DUT reported a different src_port
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never returned

verdicts.Fail_field_mismatch: DUT received UDP with wrong src_port in confirmation
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No UT confirmation for src_port check
